content.subject: Quick thought on finance automation
content.draft_text:
Hi Chermaine,
You noted Episode Six treats tech decisions like payments: flexible, scalable, problem‑focused. That suggests your finance ops likely encounter repetitive reconciliation work that consumes analyst time.
We build a connector that automatically matches transaction records to ledger entries, removing manual reconciliation steps.
Do you have 15 minutes next week to see if it could help your team quickly?
